subject.title: feat(gateway): wire read coding tool into HTTP /tools/invoke (narrow)

question: After the audit false positive is corrected, should OpenClaw expose the built-in host-filesystem `read` tool through Gateway direct invocation behind `gateway.tools.allow`, `directInvoke.hostFsRead`, and owner identity?
rationale: Tests can prove the gates, but accepting a durable authenticated host-data surface and public configuration contract is a product/security decision that no maintainer review or comment has resolved.

options.title: Accept narrow host read
options.body: Approve the read-only triple-gated capability after the audit repair, clean current-main reconciliation, and refreshed exact-head proof.

options.title: Keep coding tools agent-only
options.body: Decline direct host-file access through Gateway invocation and close this feature direction.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow host read
recommendation.body: Approve the read-only triple-gated capability after the audit repair, clean current-main reconciliation, and refreshed exact-head proof.
